system_description.narrative_title: Fragmented Order: Debt Stress, Trade Wars, Wars and Tech Rivalry
system_description.narrative_summary: The global order is an open, stressed system where simultaneous financial, geopolitical, trade and technological dynamics interact and amplify one another. US fiscal activism to stabilise a shaken bond market collides with rising sovereign debt and dollar pressure, even as Washington's hard line on Iran and China disrupts energy flows and logistics. At the same time Russia's war in Ukraine, escalating U.S.-Canada trade retaliation, and an accelerated AI/tech rivalry are reconfiguring alliances and supply chains against a backdrop of climate-driven shocks to trade routes.
system_description.scope: States and alliances, sovereign finance (treasuries, central banks, bond markets), trade and tariffs, energy flows and logistics (shipping, canals, Hormuz), defence operations and proxy wars, multinational tech and industrial competition, migration and climate shocks.
system_description.super_system: The global human socio-economic-security system embedded in planetary ecological and technological constraints.
adjacent_subsystems: Global financial markets and sovereign debt dynamics
Middle East security and energy-transit (Strait of Hormuz) dynamics
Great-power technology and industrial competition (AI, chips)
Global trade and supply-chain logistics (tariffs, Panama Canal, shipping)

variables.name: Russia-Ukraine war
variables.description: A sustained high‑intensity conflict between Russia and Ukraine that is being reshaped by Russian long‑range strikes, Ukrainian drone and missile attacks, and continuing Western military and financial support.

variables.name: Iran–Gulf escalation
variables.description: A widening Iran‑led regional confrontation with the United States and Gulf states, marked by threats to maritime transit, attacks on shipping and oil infrastructure, and the prospect of tougher U.S. economic and financial measures.

variables.name: U.S. Treasury and global bond stress
variables.description: A deepening strain in global fixed‑income markets driven by aggressive U.S. Treasury interventions, rising long‑term yields and questions over central bank credibility that are shifting the balance of financial power and dollar dynamics.

variables.name: Tech and AI great‑power rivalry
variables.description: An intensifying strategic competition among the United States, China (and increasingly the EU and others) over AI, semiconductors and critical tech where investment, regulation and market access are being weaponized to secure long‑term advantage.

variables.name: U.S.–Canada trade confrontation
variables.description: An escalating trade dispute between the United States and Canada centered on tariffs and reciprocal retaliation that is disrupting North American supply chains and testing allied economic cooperation.
